## Change

Describe the problem, supported behavior, and supported scope.

## Evidence

- Tests and observed outcomes:
- R reference version and affected comparisons:
- Numerical assumptions, intentional differences, and remaining limits:

## Review

- [ ] One focused feature or repair.
- [ ] Independent expected values or reference outputs support statistical changes.
- [ ] Code, tests, documentation and coverage map agree.
- [ ] Necessary terms and result meanings are explained in clear English.
- [ ] Source and installed-wheel checks pass.
- [ ] No credentials, restricted data, private correspondence or build caches are included.
- [ ] Attribution and license notices are preserved.
